name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
description: Hinged forward with a flat back, pull the dumbbells up toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades, then lower.

source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Soften your knees and hinge forward from the hips until your back is at about 45° or lower, arms hanging.
cues: Keep your back flat and your neck in line.
Lead with your elbows, pulling toward your hips.

prescription.note: Pick a weight you can lift for every rep with good form. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Row
keyframes.cue: Pull the weights up toward your hips.
